hook: Ravi Radhakrishnan is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Information Officer, American Express, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Ravi Radhakrishnan's LinkedIn profile, the post began in January 2022, after Wells Fargo from 2012 to 2021 and Citi from 1994 to 2012.
